pr_title: Add authentication to tplink integration for newer devices

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->

This PR will enable authentication and connection parameters in the tplink integration to passed to newer devices or devices with updated firmware.

This requires a version bump to a new major python-kasa release, which adds support for the following previously unsupported devices:

* Newer kasa-branded devices, including Matter-enabled devices like KP125M
* Newer hardware/firmware versions on some models, like EP25, that suddenly changed the used protocol
* Tapo-branded devices like plugs (P110), light bulbs (KL530), LED strips (L900, L920), wall switches (KS205, KS225), and power strips (P300)
* UK variant of HS110, which was the first device using the new protocol and triggered a homeassistant alert when it happened

Upstream changelog: https://github.com/python-kasa/python-kasa/compare/0.5.4...0.6.0.1

> This seems to show the wrong name for autodetected devices ([sdb9696#2](https://github.com/sdb9696/core/pull/2)):

This is expected behaviour because the unauthenticated discovery response does not contain the device alias so we're using the `device_type` as the alias, but only until the device gets authenticated then it uses the real alias.  Similarly the model is using the `device_model` from discovery with the region suffix until the authentication completes.
